output.revised_prompt:
Create isolated production title artwork for a premium mobile slot game. Render the exact text “COIN GARDEN” once, in one centered horizontal line. The title must be the only subject and must be spelled exactly, with no additional text, symbols, logo, watermark, plaque, frame, coins, or decorative objects.

Typography: bold, chunky, rounded uppercase casino lettering, extremely clear and highly legible at mobile size. Satin champagne-gold letter faces with soft cream highlights, tasteful muted jade enamel inset accents, tiny integrated pearl studs, and subtle coin-edge bevel detailing within the letter construction. Refined, joyful, profitable premium gaming-floor aesthetic. Warm bulb-like specular highlights contained entirely on the lettering. Soft polished dimensional finish, but no cast shadow, outer glow, or illumination touching the background.

Composition: very wide centered title, perfectly horizontal, generous empty margin on all sides, consistent baseline and spacing. No surrounding plaque or frame. The lettering must not touch the canvas edges.

Background: perfectly flat, perfectly uniform solid chroma-key magenta #FF00FF across the entire background, with no gradients, texture, noise, vignette, shadow, glow, reflection, or color variation. Absolutely no magenta anywhere in the lettering.

Avoid Chinese characters, dragons, illegible script, thin letters, detached coins, black background, extra wording, duplicate text, line breaks, misspellings, and any visual element besides the title.”
